articles.summary: Vital Farms (Nasdaq: VITL), a Certified B Corporation that offers a range of ethically produced foods nationwide, will report financial results for the third quarter ended September 27, 2026, on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, before market open. Vital Farms will host a conference call and webcast at 8:30 a.m. ET on the same day to discuss the results. To participate in the conference call via phone, participants may register for the call here to receive dial-in details and a unique pin. Alternatively, participants may access the live webcast on the Vital Farms Investor Relations website at https://investors.vitalfarms.com under “Events.” The webcast will be archived for 30 days. About Vital Farms Vital Farms (Nasdaq: VITL) is a Certified B Corporation that offers a range of ethically produced foods nationwide. articles.summary: The Behind Every Carton Tour will bring real family farmers to more than 20 Sprouts Farmers Market stores across Colorado, Arizona and California starting October 13; Vital Farms will also launch new nationwide out-of-home and digital creative in partnership with GUT Miami and Dentsu X highlighting the brand’s “See The Farm” initiative. Vital Farms (Nasdaq: VITL) announced today the launch of the “Behind Every Carton” campaign, which celebrates the more than 600 real family farms that help bring ethical food to the table every day. Behind Every Carton celebrates Vital Farms’ direct relationships with the farmers who produce eggs for consumers every day. At a time when much of the egg aisle feels far removed from the farm, Vital Farms takes a different approach, building real connections with the real people who care for the hens and do the work. articles.title: Vital Farms Launches the “Behind Every Carton” Campaign to Show Consumers the Real Farms and Farmers Who Produce the Good Eggs Every Day

articles.summary: New offering aims to reach more households at an accessible price point while maintaining Vital Farms’ commitments to animal welfare, quality and transparency. Vital Farms (Nasdaq: VITL) announced today the pilot launch of Vital Farms Free-Range eggs, which are expected to arrive in select Target retail stores across the South and Southeast beginning this week. This limited test is designed to explore how Vital Farms can reach more households with a high-quality product at a more accessible suggested retail price point of less than $5 per carton, while maintaining its commitment to transparency and animal welfare. Introducing A New Vital Farms Standard “Free-range” is one of the most familiar terms in the egg aisle, but the standard itself doesn’t consistently tell consumers what they are actually buying. articles.title: Vital Farms Introduces a Higher Standard for Free-Range Eggs Through Limited Pilot at Select Target Retail Stores
